Explain the example for use one listener for a list

blocks.text: Events often travel from a child to its parent. A parent listener can handle buttons that are added to a list later.
The HTML examples are complete small page parts. Use this site's HTML Run button. Put the script after the elements it uses so those elements already exist.

blocks.title: Use one listener for a list

blocks.text: Read the code step by step

items: `textContent` reads or replaces plain text inside an element. It does not interpret the supplied words as HTML.
`addEventListener` waits for the named event before calling the function you pass to it.
`dataset` reads `data-...` attributes as text values. Convert a numeric value explicitly before doing arithmetic.

blocks.text: Clicking Choose shows Moon Trip. The listener lives on the parent div.

blocks.title: A mistake to avoid
blocks.text: Check that a matching button was found before reading its data. The parent can receive clicks on empty space too.
